question: What transformative power does meditation on the goddess united with Mahākāla confer on a dull-minded person?
premises: The goddess is engaged in love-union with Mahākāla.
A person may meditate on her in that state.
Even a dull-minded meditator becomes a poet.
inference: Meditating on the goddess united with Mahākāla transforms even a dull-minded person into a poet.
plain_english: O Mother, even one of dull mind becomes a poet by meditating on you as engaged in love-union with Mahākāla.
